summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I ran the program, found it failed on a wrong import (`greetings` instead of `greeter`) in `main.py`, and also found a missing colon in `def greet(name)` in `greeter.py`. I fixed both with small edits so `python3 main.py` now runs cleanly and prints `Hello, world!`
